d: 枣木明火烤出脆皮，卷进薄饼配葱丝和甜面酱。
Crisp-skinned roast duck, wrapped in thin pancakes with scallion and sweet bean sauce.
醋饭配新鲜鱼生，讲究刀工与时令。
Vinegared rice topped with fresh fish, all about knife skill and season.
薄皮裹着肉馅和汤汁，先咬小口再喝汤。
Thin-skinned soup dumplings filled with pork and hot broth.
桌边炭火烤五花肉，裹生菜配泡菜和蒜片。
Pork belly grilled at the table, wrapped in lettuce with kimchi and garlic.
香茅、南姜、青柠叶熬出酸辣鲜香的虾汤。
Hot and sour shrimp soup with lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves.
豚骨、酱油、味噌，各地各有一碗招牌汤面。
Noodles in pork-bone, soy or miso broth, with a style for every region.
红烧汤头配大块牛腱和手工面。
Braised beef shank and chewy noodles in a rich, spiced broth.
海鲜和蔬菜裹上薄面衣，炸得轻盈酥脆。
Seafood and vegetables in a light, crisp batter.
牛油红汤，麻辣滚烫，毛肚鸭肠七上八下。
Fiery beef-tallow broth loaded with Sichuan pepper, for dipping tripe and more.
椰浆或酸鱼汤底的米粉，香料味浓郁。
Noodles in spicy coconut or tangy fish broth, rich with spices.
清澈牛骨汤配宽米粉和生牛肉片，配香草和青柠。
Rice noodles in clear beef broth with rare beef, herbs and lime.
白切鸡配鸡油饭和辣椒酱，新加坡国民美食。
Poached chicken with fragrant rice and chili sauce, Singapore’s national dish.
浓茶用丝袜滤过，再加淡奶，茶味浓、口感滑。
Strong black tea strained through cloth and mixed with evaporated milk.
米饭上铺满蔬菜、肉和蛋，拌上辣酱一起吃。
Rice topped with vegetables, meat and egg, mixed with chili paste.
圆滚滚的面糊球里有章鱼块，淋酱撒木鱼花。
Batter balls with octopus inside, topped with sauce and bonito flakes.
河粉配虾、豆芽、花生碎，酸甜咸辣平衡。
Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, bean sprouts and peanuts.
牛肉与椰浆香料慢炖数小时，收得干香入味。
Beef slow-cooked for hours in coconut milk and spices until dark and rich.
嫩豆腐配牛肉末和花椒，麻、辣、烫、香。
Silky tofu in a numbing, spicy sauce with minced beef and Sichuan pepper.
卷心菜面糊在铁板上煎成厚饼，配料随你选。
A savory cabbage pancake cooked on a griddle with your choice of toppings.
一清二白三红四绿，现拉的面配清亮牛骨汤。
Hand-pulled noodles in clear beef broth with radish, chili oil and herbs.
按季节编排的多道小菜，像一场餐桌上的展览。
A seasonal multi-course meal, arranged like an exhibition on the table.
法棍夹着肉、肝酱、腌萝卜和香菜。
A baguette filled with meats, pâté, pickled vegetables and coriander.
奶茶里加上有嚼劲的黑糖珍珠，用粗吸管喝。
Milk tea with chewy tapioca pearls, sipped through a wide straw.
一盅两件：虾饺、烧卖、叉烧包配一壶茶。
Tea with bite-sized dishes like har gow, siu mai and char siu buns.
宇治茶叶磨成细粉，用竹刷打出细密泡沫。
Stone-ground green tea from Uji, whisked into a fine froth.
辣椒腌的发酵白菜，几乎每餐都有。
Spicy fermented napa cabbage, served with almost every meal.
椰浆煮的米饭配辣椒酱、花生、小鱼干和蛋。
Coconut rice with sambal, peanuts, anchovies and egg.
香甜芒果配椰浆糯米，泰国夏天的味道。
Sweet mango with coconut sticky rice, the taste of a Thai summer.
西湖边的扁平绿茶，清香带豆香。
Flat green tea leaves from the hills around West Lake.
雪花般的油花，入口即化。
Beef with fine marbling that melts in the mouth.
近乎完美的圆锥形火山，河口湖边看倒影最美。
A near-perfect volcanic cone, best mirrored in Lake Kawaguchi.
蜿蜒在群山脊线上的城墙，慕田峪、金山岭最上镜。
Walls snaking along mountain ridges; Mutianyu and Jinshanling are the most photogenic.
明清两代的皇宫，红墙黄瓦，殿宇连绵。
The imperial palace of the Ming and Qing, red walls and golden roofs as far as you can see.
像竹节一样层层向上的摩天楼，跨年烟火从楼身放出。
A skyscraper rising in bamboo-like segments, with New Year fireworks off its sides.
上万座朱红鸟居连成隧道，一路通向山顶。
Thousands of vermilion torii gates forming tunnels up the mountain.
金光闪闪的尖塔和玉佛寺，泰国王室的象征。
Gleaming spires and the Emerald Buddha, the heart of the Thai monarchy.
上千座石灰岩岛屿从翡翠色海面升起。
Thousands of limestone islands rising from emerald water.
秦始皇陵的陶俑军阵，每个人的面孔都不一样。
The clay army of China’s first emperor, every face different.
贴满金箔的楼阁倒映在镜湖池里。
A gold-leaf pavilion reflected in its mirror pond.
两座银色高塔由空中天桥相连。
Twin silver towers joined by a skybridge.
断桥、苏堤、雷峰塔，烟雨中最美。
Bridges, causeways and pagodas, loveliest in misty rain.
世界最大的宗教建筑，日出时倒映在莲花池里。
The world’s largest religious monument, mirrored in lotus ponds at dawn.

l: 马格朗 · 印度尼西亚
d: 世界最大的佛教遗址，晨雾里的火山群环绕四周。
The world’s largest Buddhist temple, ringed by volcanoes in morning mist.
两岸摩天楼灯火，天星小轮来回穿梭。
Skyscraper lights on both shores, Star Ferries crossing between.
高耸的竹林小径，风吹过沙沙作响。
A path through towering bamboo that rustles in the wind.
朝鲜王朝的正宫，穿韩服可免费入场。
The main palace of the Joseon dynasty; free entry in hanbok.
喀斯特山峰倒映在江面，二十元人民币上的风景。
Karst peaks reflected in the river, the view on the 20-yuan note.
东京最古老的寺庙，雷门大灯笼下人来人往。
Tokyo’s oldest temple, crowds passing under the giant Kaminarimon lantern.
三千多座石英砂岩峰柱拔地而起，常被云雾环绕。
Thousands of sandstone pillars rising into the clouds.
金沙酒店、超级树和鱼尾狮组成的城市风景。
Marina Bay Sands, the Supertrees and the Merlion.
绿灯一亮，上千人从四面八方同时过马路。
When the lights turn green, a thousand people cross at once.
奇松、怪石、云海，日出时最壮观。
Twisted pines, granite peaks and seas of cloud at sunrise.
建在红山上的宫堡，海拔三千七百米。
A palace-fortress on Red Hill, 3,700 metres up.
海边的火山口，是看日出的好地方。
A seaside volcanic crater, made for watching sunrise.
洁白的天守阁像展翅的白鹭，保存最完好的日本古城。
A brilliant white castle like a heron in flight, Japan’s best preserved.
一边是百年西式建筑，一边是陆家嘴天际线。
Century-old facades on one bank, the Lujiazui skyline on the other.
黄墙老街挂满丝绸灯笼，夜里河上放河灯。
Yellow streets hung with silk lanterns, candles floating on the river at night.
涨潮时朱红大鸟居仿佛漂在海上。
At high tide its great red torii seems to float on the sea.

l: 乌布市场 · 印度尼西亚
d: 层层绿色梯田依山谷而下，椰树点缀其间。
Green rice terraces stepping down a valley among palms.
山城石阶上挂满红灯笼，俯瞰大海。
Lantern-lined stone steps on a hillside above the sea.
彩色湖泊和瀑布藏在高山林间。
Jewel-colored lakes and waterfalls in mountain forest.
湄南河畔镶满彩瓷的佛塔，日落时最美。
A riverside spire studded with porcelain, glowing at sunset.
上千只鹿在东大寺周围自由走动，会向人鞠躬讨饼。
Over a thousand deer roam around Tōdai-ji and bow for crackers.
沙漠边上的石窟群，千年壁画和佛像。
Desert cave temples filled with a thousand years of murals.
沙丘环抱着一弯泉水，千百年来未被流沙掩埋。
A crescent spring cradled by dunes, never swallowed by the sand.
合掌造的茅草屋村落，冬天积雪像童话。
Steep thatched farmhouses that look like a fairy tale under snow.
穿着浴衣坐在河边，看上万发烟花在头顶绽开。
Sitting by the river in a yukata as tens of thousands of fireworks burst overhead.
贴春联、放鞭炮、吃年夜饭，一年中最热闹的团圆。
Couplets, firecrackers and the reunion dinner, the biggest celebration of the year.
互相抛撒彩色粉末，迎接春天。
Throwing colored powder at everyone to welcome spring.
泰国新年，满街打水仗。
Thai New Year, when the whole country turns into a water fight.
鼓点中跳起祈祷舞，满城彩色游行。
Prayer dances to pounding drums and a riot of color in the streets.
用松花江冰块砌成的城堡，夜里亮起彩灯。
Castles built from river ice, lit in color at night.
点亮千万盏油灯和烟花，庆祝光明战胜黑暗。
Countless oil lamps and fireworks celebrate light over darkness.
信众背着装饰华丽的“卡瓦迪”登上两百七十二级台阶。
Devotees carry ornate kavadi up 272 steps to the caves.
在盛开的樱花树下铺开野餐垫，喝酒赏花。
Picnics and drinks beneath blossoming cherry trees.
一边走一边吃：盐酥鸡、蚵仔煎、珍珠奶茶。
Eating as you walk: fried chicken, oyster omelettes, bubble tea.

l: 巴彦乌列盖 · 蒙古国
d: 哈萨克族猎鹰人骑马放鹰，比试默契。
Kazakh eagle hunters on horseback show off their bond with their birds.
祭司举着火灯向恒河致敬，河面漂满花灯。
Priests raise flaming lamps to the Ganges as flower lamps float by.
苏菲修士一手向天一手向地，不停旋转进入冥想。
Sufi dervishes spin in meditation, one palm to the sky, one to the earth.
一碗抹茶的点、奉、饮都有讲究，讲的是“一期一会”。
Every step of preparing and drinking matcha is ritual, a once-in-a-lifetime encounter.
“八条肢体的艺术”，比赛前选手跳古老的拜师舞。
The ‘art of eight limbs’; fighters dance a ritual tribute before each bout.
锣鼓声中，狮子跳上高桩，“采青”迎来好运。
To drums and gongs, lions leap across poles to ‘pluck the greens’ for luck.
波斯新年，摆上“七样S开头的东西”，跳火堆迎春。
Persian New Year with the haft-sin table and jumping over bonfires.

l: 巴厘岛 · 印度尼西亚
d: 上百人围坐齐声吟唱，演出《罗摩衍那》的故事。
A circle of chanting men tells the Ramayana as the sun sets.
盛装的大象驮着佛牙舍利夜游古城。
Decorated elephants parade the Sacred Tooth Relic through the night.
恒河上游的瑜伽之都，在河边晨练冥想。
The yoga capital on the upper Ganges, practice and meditation by the river.
脸谱、唱腔和身段，一出戏讲尽忠奸善恶。
Painted faces, song and stylized movement telling tales of heroes and villains.
千年历史的祭典，巨大的山鉾花车在街上巡行。
A thousand-year-old festival of towering floats rolling through the streets.
清晨的公园里，一群人跟着节奏缓缓推手。
At dawn in the park, groups move slowly in unison.
上万头骆驼和商人聚到沙漠小镇交易、比赛。
Thousands of camels and traders gather in a desert town.
小船载着水果和米粉，在运河上做买卖。
Boats laden with fruit and noodles trade along the canals.
力士撒盐、踏步、对撞，几秒钟分出胜负。
Wrestlers throw salt, stamp and collide; bouts end in seconds.
t: Tokyo tournaments in Jan, May, Sep
